title: Porsche Electric Macan Turbo Details Revealed
excerpt: Porsche's 2026 electric Macan Turbo features 630 horsepower and a 100-kilowatt-hour battery in a two-row crossover layout.
body_html:
Porsche has detailed specifications for its upcoming electric crossover, highlighting the performance capabilities of the new model.

The 2026 Porsche Macan Turbo EV is designed as a two-row vehicle. It delivers 630 horsepower and is equipped with a 100-kilowatt-hour battery pack.
